introSubtitle: Vroom is committed to your safety. Learn about the tools and features designed to protect you before, during, and after every trip.
driverVerificationDesc: All drivers go through background checks and document verification before they can drive with Vroom.
vehicleVerificationDesc: Every vehicle is inspected and matched to the driver's registered documents.
shareMyTripDesc: Share your live trip status and location with a trusted contact in real time.
emergencyButtonDesc: Quickly contact emergency services or Vroom support directly from the app.
rideCheckDesc: We automatically detect unusual trip activity, like unexpected stops or route changes, and check in with you.
inAppReportingDesc: Report any safety concern directly through the app during or after your trip.
rateAndReviewDesc: Your feedback helps us maintain safety standards for every driver.
support247Desc: Our safety team is available around the clock to respond to any incident.
tips: Always check the driver's name, photo, and license plate match the app before getting in.
Sit in the back seat when riding alone.
Share your trip details with someone you trust.
